description: Native static block prop contract for bark leaf decorations, explicit R rotation variants and independent replication/anchor verification.
changes: Keep approved 5/10/15 constant-size leaves, palette and one-cell floor hitboxes
Declare NESW in final block packets, with base plus three alternative yaw rotations
Use PropComponent, native block transform and cube-centre offset; rebuild derived components from persisted leaf data on load
Preserve a precomputed Y-X-Z selection box instead of allowing the X-Y-Z generic AABB helper to overwrite it
advantages: Repairs existing attachments on load without offline world writes
Native trackers emit full transform with block and prop descriptors
All previous models, textures and icons remain byte-identical
disadvantages: Real client appearance and physical R-key preview await user acceptance
Exact client frame matrix and separate prop-marker pixel contribution were not instrumented
test_results: M sample checked in editor before all variants

Native 1.11.0 countercheck fails the strengthened tangent transform assertion as expected
226 existing assets byte-identical; installation hash and backup verified
